# <System Name>

## Purpose

What this system does and why it exists.

## Questions this doc answers

Practical questions this document is meant to answer.

## Scope

What is included in this system.

## Non-scope

What this system does not own, especially where boundaries are easy to misunderstand.

## Key concepts

Domain concepts, states, entities, and terms used by this system. Use Title Case for terms defined in `docs/glossary.md` when it improves clarity.

## How the system works

Behavioral explanation: important mechanics, responsibilities, and interactions. Do not restate every implementation detail.

## Important flows

Major flows handled by this system. Link to separate flow docs when a flow is large, cross-system, frequently changed, frequently debugged, or important enough to review independently.

## Data and state

Persisted data, in-memory state, caches, queues, external state, or derived state used by this system.

## Interfaces and entry points

Main ways this system is used: API routes, UI entry points, background jobs, event handlers, webhooks, services, public functions, or external integrations.

## Dependencies

Systems, services, packages, APIs, or infrastructure this system depends on.

## Downstream effects

Other systems that may be affected when this system changes.

## Invariants and assumptions

Rules that must remain true for the system to behave correctly.

## Error handling

Important failure modes and how the system handles them.

## Security and privacy notes

Security-sensitive behavior, permissions, authentication, authorization, user data handling, and privacy assumptions. Omit only if clearly irrelevant.

## Observability and debugging

How to debug this system: logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, admin screens, commands, or common symptoms.

## Testing notes

Important tests and how to validate changes.

## Common pitfalls

Things contributors or agents are likely to misunderstand.

## Source map

Relative Markdown links to the most important source files. Do not list every file unless the system is small.

## Related docs

Links to related system docs, flow docs, ADRs, glossary entries, or external references.
